config._note: Supervisor thresholds and budgets for scripts/task/cut_fsm.py. Exploratory simulation values, not clinical limits.

tension.basis: Tension = median constraint strain of the sheet. In the first CoppeliaSim run the cut itself lowered it from 0.065 to 0.036, which the single 0.04 bound reported as lost tension.

events.relax_basis: Injected test perturbation, not a tissue property: the 'relax' event drives each arm holding tissue this far toward the cut line to model retractor creep. The default is sized inside the RETRACT_ADJUST recovery budget (4 attempts x 0.2 mm per arm) so the 'relax' scenario exercises recovery; the 'relax_large' scenario overrides it to exceed the budget and is expected to fail.

vision.basis: config/task/m5b_protocol.json: a remembered front fix stays usable for this many world ticks after its last valid estimate.

perception.basis: M4 shadow perception (scripts/vision/cut_perception.py): 'off' logs nothing, 'shadow' runs the estimator on the already-acquired image/depth each observe() and logs estimate + truth + errors into the report. It is never used for control unless cut.control_source is 'vision'. 'markers' stages two cyan/yellow spheres on the cutter yaw housing (non-respondable); kept on in both modes so the off-vs-shadow comparison isolates the estimator. depth_noise_m/camera_pose_error perturb ONLY the estimator inputs (seeded per run). camera_pose_error.mode: 'per_tick' draws a fresh error each tick (M5a semantics); 'fixed' draws the rotation axis and translation direction once per run (a calibration bias, config/task/m5b_protocol.json).

cut.control_source_basis: config/task/m5b_protocol.json: 'truth' (default, unchanged behaviour) or 'vision' — the cutter's front, alignment, advance, stop and visibility come from the cut_perception estimate; tension/grasped stay truth until M6, tear/overcut stay truth safety monitors.
cut.clear_back_basis: config/task/m5b_protocol.json CLEAR_VIEW attempt 1: cutter backs this far off along its jaw axis, jaws unchanged, to re-observe the front.
cut.align_mode_basis: shaft drives the scissors with setRCMTarget only; tool_pose instead solves one 6-DOF shaft+wrist command (setToolPose) so the jaw pointing axis tracks the cut line. Wrist articulation is verified in this scene. Default tool_pose: live full nominal and occlusion_transient both DONE with closure lateral error 0.01 mm vs 0.63 mm for shaft, same cut length, tearing and strain (validation/task/sim_full_*_tool_pose.json).
cut.overcut_basis: One 1 mm row of the current tissue grid is allowed in this discrete benchmark. Report actual overshoot; this is not a clinical safety margin or a bound on blade sweep.
cut.retract_step_basis: 0.5 mm steps tore a constraint beside the grasp in the first full run: the position solver could not spread a 0.5 mm jump of the pinned nodes within one step.

budgets.clear_view_attempts_basis: config/task/m5b_protocol.json: consecutive clear-and-look attempts before FAILED (back-off, withdrawal-if-closed, look-only).

notes: cut_length_m comes from the tissue node geometry (rows separated along the cut line), not from vision. Visibility uses the rendered endoscope depth buffer.
